dedupe_keys.name: 松江駅構内人流センサテータ 8月 railways and stations series on g spatial information center

description: 松江駅構内人流センサデータ 8月 [railways and stations] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 人流解析チーム. 松江駅構内17箇所に設置した人流センサのデータです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 104 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 人流解析チーム. Its tags are 人流, 松江. It offers 34 resource(s) in csv, mp4, png, txt. The portal shows 2025-09-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
